description: This file defines the PHP class `AOR_Field`, which extends the `Basic` class. It represents a data model for 'AOR_Field' in the SuiteCRM system, managing properties related to fields within the AOR module, including methods for saving lines of data associated with the object. The class includes various property definitions for the database schema, and a method `save_lines()` for processing related form data.

classes.name: AOR_Field
classes.description: Represents a custom field in the AOR module with properties for database mapping and methods for data handling.

methods.name: save_lines
methods.description: Handles processing and saving of multiple line items related to the AOR_Field, based on posted data, including handling deletions and nested data serialization.
